subject: RelayBridge temporary subprocessor swap — request for evidence and acknowledgement
messages:
From: Imani Okoye <imani.okoye@relaybridge.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Notice: temporary subprocessor swap for telemetry relay

Hi Connor,

Quick heads up — RelayBridge is doing a temporary subprocessor swap for our telemetry relay in the US-West region to mitigate a capacity issue with our primary telemetry partner.

What is changing
- Effective window: 2029-12-10 00:00 UTC to 2029-12-20 23:59 UTC (tentative).
- New temporary subprocessors: "ReliaCloud Transit" (relia-transit.relaybridge.io) for metric ingestion and "ReliaCloud Storage" for short-term buffering.

Impact summary (short):
- No customer PII is stored by the relay; the relay takes telemetry + anonymized metadata.
- Data in transit will continue to be encrypted (TLS 1.3) and buffered for up to 48 hours before backfill to permanent stores.
- Cross-border: traffic remains within US regions for this window.

Action requested from Redwood:
1) Please confirm acceptance or raise objections by 2029-12-05 EOD PST.
2) We attached the temporary subprocessor manifest and a minimal evidence packet (SOC2 sys description excerpt, encryption notes). Please review and tell us if you need anything else.

Attachments:
- relaybridge_subprocessor_manifest.csv (CSV listing hostnames, vendor contact, and retention)
- relaybridge_evidence_packet_v1.zip (contains SOC2 excerpt, TLS config summary)

If helpful I can hop on a 20-min call to review the flow.

Thanks,
Imani
Imani Okoye
Head of Vendor Ops, RelayBridge
imani.okoye@relaybridge.io
+1 415-555-0176

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Imani Okoye <imani.okoye@relaybridge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-12-03T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Notice: temporary subprocessor swap for telemetry relay

Hi Imani — thanks for the early notice and the attachments, I pulled the manifest and started a quick pass. A couple of questions before we confirm: 

- Can you confirm whether any KV/trace identifiers that could be linked to user IDs are included in the relay payloads during the buffer window? Our policy requires pseudonymization for any identifier that can be re-linked.
- Please send a short data-flow diagram (even an export from your internal diagram tool) showing the path tenant -> relay -> temporary buffer -> permanent store. The Drive link in your email returns a 404 for me.
- SOC2 excerpt looked like the right section; we need a statement of control owner and last test date on the encryption controls (field we track in our DPA addendum).

Marissa — tagging you for any product-level concerns (retention / replay windows).
Kimberly — looping you in on legal/compliance questions below; if we need a DPA addendum for this temporary swap we'll flag it.

I can confirm tentatively if I get answers by 2029-12-05; otherwise we may request a controlled canary (1% of telemetry) before full routing.

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Sr. Product Ops Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Imani Okoye <imani.okoye@relaybridge.io>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-12-05T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Notice: temporary subprocessor swap for telemetry relay

Imani — thanks for the message. A few compliance items we need clarified before Redwood can accept the swap: 

1) Encryption & key management - Please confirm whether ReliaCloud Storage will use customer-controlled keys or keys managed by ReliaCloud. If the latter, provide the KMS jurisdiction and whether HSM-backed keys are used for the buffer.
2) Retention & deletion - You stated "buffered for up to 48 hours" — we need confirmation that deletion is automatic and auditable; provide the retention policy ID or deletion playbook.
3) Access controls and auditors - Provide a short list of engineering roles/accounts that will have access to the buffer and whether access is logged to a central audit trail accessible for vendor audit.
4) Evidence timeline - We need the SOC2 test date for the relevant control (encryption-in-transit/at-rest) and the contact at ReliaCloud Security in case our SOC team requests a bridge call.

Also, if this requires a DPA addendum we will request DocuSign routing. Please provide a link to any proposed addendum text or confirm you will accept Redwood's one-time addendum language (we can share a redline).

For tracking: I've created a JIRA ticket SUP-1123 (procurement/compliance) and added the manifest; please reference that ticket ID in any replies.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Imani Okoye <imani.okoye@relaybridge.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ReliaCloud Security <security@reliacloud.com>
Date: 2029-12-11T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Notice: temporary subprocessor swap for telemetry relay

Thanks — quick update and attachments included.

Answers inline: 
- KV/Trace identifiers: RelayBridge confirms no direct user IDs are sent to the temporary storage; payloads include a hashed trace_id (one-way) and a 30-day rolling pseudonymization salt. We included a short pseudonymization description in relaybridge_evidence_packet_v1.zip under /pseudonymization.md.
- Data flow diagram: uploaded to the Drive link below and also included as a PNG in the evidence zip. Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcDeFgRelaybridgeDataFlow
- Encryption/KMS: ReliaCloud Storage uses ReliaCloud-managed KMS; keys are HSM-backed and reside in us-west-2 (AWS). We attached the KMS jurisdiction statement (relaybridge_kms_stmt.pdf inside the zip).
- Retention/deletion: automatic deletion is performed by a retention job; deletion is logged to ReliaCloud Audit (exportable). See /deletion_playbook.pdf in the evidence zip.
- SOC2: relevant control tested on 2029-10-21; contact at ReliaCloud Security is security@reliacloud.com.

Attachments included in this reply (stubs):
- relaybridge_subprocessor_manifest.csv
- relaybridge_evidence_packet_v1.zip (contains pseudonymization.md, relaybridge_kms_stmt.pdf, deletion_playbook.pdf, dataflow_diagram.png)

We are happy to accept Redwood's one-time addendum if you send a redline; otherwise we can circulate our short addendum. If you prefer, we can do a 30-minute bridge on 2029-12-12 (we're available 09:00-12:00 PST).

On Sun, Dec 1, 2029 at 09:12 AM Imani Okoye <imani.okoye@relaybridge.io> wrote:
> Quick heads up — RelayBridge is doing a temporary subprocessor swap for our telemetry relay in the US-West region to mitigate a capacity issue with our primary telemetry partner.
>
> Attachments: relaybridge_subprocessor_manifest.csv, relaybridge_evidence_packet_v1.zip

Let us know next steps.

Best,
Imani
